neighbours.label: Just before an uppercase abbreviation piece whose second letter is L (PL, SL, GL, CL ...): fires on ' (' when the spelled-out name makes such an acronym next, e.g. 'Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)'; reversed output suppresses ' CL', ' PL', ' EL', ' GL'
fire: The script is run from the Command Line Interface (CLI) on the server.
Each batch is tested under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) rules.
The vendor missed the Service Level Objective (SLO) twice this month.
The valve is opened by a Programmable Logic Array (PLA) on the board.
Overtime pay is covered by the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) in most cases.
The wage figures come from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) each month.
He bought a Single Lens Reflex (SLR) camera for the trip.
The samples were measured with an Enzyme Linked Assay (ELA) kit.
quiet: The script is run from the Remote Desktop Service (RDS) on the server.
Each batch is tested under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) rules.
The vendor missed the Key Performance Indicator (KPI) twice this month.
The valve is opened by a Field Effect Transistor (FET) on the board.
Overtime pay is covered by the Department of Transportation (DOT) in some cases.
The wage figures come from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) each month.
He bought a Global Positioning System (GPS) receiver for the trip.
The samples were measured with a Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) kit.

notes: Probes: '(PLM)' 0.55, '(SLA)' 0.62, '(PLC)' 0.26, '(GDL)' 0.31; '(CRM)', '(CIA)', '(GDP)', '(HTML)', '(SQL)' 0.01-0.04. Corpus top examples also include uppercase identifiers before LANG, LOVE, LEVEL.
